Best valid = 0.000 (empty plant). 49/50 solves used; this revert restores the empty design as final.

Key learnings: column cost dominates — a single modest 30-stage/R=2 column costs $146M/yr. Revenue needs >=95% purity (blend or pure), and no single column can make such a stream because no blend/component exceeds ~29% of feed while the purity bar is 95%. Multi-column trains reached only ~66% C5 mix; all net-negative (best seen ~ -0.2). Revenue scale: C6paraffin ~1185M, C5mix 618M, C6naphthene 396M, pure nC5 438M, C4mix 186M, C3mix 73M. Hardest splits: nC6/MCP 3K, iC5/nC5 8K, 2,2DMB/iC5 14K; wide easy gaps: C4/C5 (~28K) and C5/C6 (~30K). Other island plants (R1591, R1593) both FAILED to converge on their 2-column trains, i.e. invalid. My final call: keep empty 0.000 rather than risk an invalid last solve.
